title: Dawn, 1945
synopsis: A bookseller takes his son through dawn streets to a secret library. The boy chooses a forgotten novel and begins to read it that same night.

title: Chapter 1
synopsis: Carax is missing from every catalogue. Father and son consult Gustavo Barceló at Els Quatre Gats. The collector offers money. Daniel refuses.

title: Chapter 2
synopsis: At the Ateneo, Barceló examines the book beside his niece Clara. He says it is now unique. Clara is blind; Daniel cannot look away.

title: Chapter 3
synopsis: Clara tells how she first met Carax’s work in France, and how her father was murdered in Montjuïc Castle after the war began.

title: Chapter 4
synopsis: Someone has been buying Carax’s books in order to burn them. Clara’s mother learned a name: Javier Fumero, now a policeman. Daniel offers to read aloud.

title: Chapter 5
synopsis: A remembered pen he could not have. A question about the war that his father will not answer. On the street, Daniel thinks someone is watching.
